gaps.sentence: I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: Come on, join ___ — it's easy once you start.
gaps.explanation: join in = take part in an activity others are doing.

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: The fire blew ___ the gas cylinder exploded.
gaps.explanation: blow up = explode, or make something explode.

gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.
